summary: Perry County lookout near Pinnacle Butte, NW of Perryville; a survey record with a 1967 station recovery places the tower near the station. Current status unknown.

facts.status_note: The newest dated account found is a 1967 survey station recovery; no current source confirms that the tower stands.

visit.trail_note: Survey directions: from the post office in Adona, east on State Highway 10 for 0.6 mile to a side road on the right, then south on a dirt road for 3.7 miles to the tower and station.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The page title and web address say Fourche Mountain, but the page heading and the state index say Fourche Pinnacle. The record keeps Fourche Pinnacle, the name used by the heading and the index.

sources.title: Fourche Mountain (heading Fourche Pinnacle) - FOREST LOOKOUTS (reproduces NGS station description PID FG1758)

notes_for_editor: Two web sources, both from the Forest Lookouts site: a reproduced 1967-era National Geodetic Survey station description (undated on the page) and the state index. Nothing on build date, height, design, staffing, fires, fate or current condition. The NGS text calls the nearby structure 'the Pinnacle, lookout tower', so it is not certain the survey tower is the same structure the agency lists; the index ties the Fourche Pinnacle name to Perry County and the Arkansas State Forestry Commission. Brief values checked: agency and Perry County supported; height left null because no source gives one. Brief status (unknown) kept. Searches: two web searches; the Preserve Arkansas 2007 list and Encyclopedia of Arkansas entries were read and say nothing about this tower. The Anyplace America topo page returned 403. The USGS quad date printed on the page (Perryville, 1989) is a map edition, not an account of the site, so the 1967 station recovery stays the latest dated account.
